item.title: White House Accused of ‘Gangsterism at Home and Piracy at Sea’
item.description: The Scottish Greens have condemned the use of Wick Airport in US military operations, accusing the Trump administration of lawless foreign policy and urging clear assurances that Scotland’s infrastructure will not be used in future overseas actions.The post White House Accused of ‘Gangsterism at Home and Piracy at Sea’ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: How Work is Being Found Across The Highlands is Quietly Changing
item.description: Work across the Highlands is being found in a new way, with jobs now sitting inside trusted local spaces people already use every day. The Highland Times network is quietly reshaping how employers and jobseekers connect.The post How Work is Being Found Across The Highlands is Quietly Changing appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Starmer’s Cost-of-Living Failure Blamed as Retail Footfall Slumps in December
item.description: Retail footfall fell sharply across Scotland in December as households cut back amid rising bills and food costs, with new figures and polling fuelling criticism of Labour’s handling of the cost-of-living crisis and its impact on local businesses.The post Starmer’s Cost-of-Living Failure Blamed as Retail Footfall Slumps in December appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Fresh Amber Snow Warning Brings Further Disruption Across Much of Scotland
item.description: Heavy snow, strong winds and rising flood risk are set to bring further disruption across the Highlands and beyond, as fresh amber and yellow weather warnings come into force and communities are urged to plan ahead and stay safe.The post Fresh Amber Snow Warning Brings Further Disruption Across Much of Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Extra Grit Supplies Rolled Out Across Inverness After Prolonged Severe Weather
item.description: Extra grit supplies have been rolled out across Inverness after prolonged severe weather, as a new pilot gives communities practical support to tackle icy conditions while road crews focus on priority routes and winter resilience planning continues. The post Extra Grit Supplies Rolled Out Across Inverness After Prolonged Severe Weather appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Munro Backs Call to End Scotland’s Energy Bill Rip Off
item.description: Calls are growing to end what campaigners describe as an energy bill rip off for Scottish households, as SNP candidate Eilidh Munro backs demands for fair pricing, lower standing charges, and greater control over Scotland’s energy future.The post Munro Backs Call to End Scotland’s Energy Bill Rip Off appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Over £1.76 Million Boost for Scotland’s Internationally Important Rainforest
item.description: More than £1.76 million is being invested in restoring Scotland’s rare temperate rainforest, supporting community led projects from Argyll to Assynt that protect biodiversity, create jobs, and strengthen west coast resilience against climate change.The post Over £1.76 Million Boost for Scotland’s Internationally Important Rainforest appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Police Issue Fresh Travel Advice as Snow Warnings Remain in Place
item.description: Fresh amber and yellow weather warnings remain in place across parts of Scotland, with police urging people to plan ahead, avoid unnecessary travel, and look out for others as snow, ice and flooding risks continue.The post Police Issue Fresh Travel Advice as Snow Warnings Remain in Place appeared first on The Highland Times.
